# IInstitutionalVaultRegistry
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/interfaces/IInstitutionalVaultRegistry.sol)

**Inherits:**
[IInstitutionalVaultRegistryErrors](./i-institutional-vault-registry-errors.md), [IInstitutionalVaultRegistryEvents](./i-institutional-vault-registry-events.md)

**Title:**
IInstitutionalVaultRegistry

Single source of truth for institutional vault wiring.

Stores component addresses keyed by institution id (bytes32). Governor-managed.


## Functions
### getBytes32InstitutionId

VIEW

Derives a bytes32 institution id from a UTF-8 string name.

This is a raw cast: strings longer than 32 bytes are truncated; shorter strings are right-padded with zeros.
Use only if the naming convention guarantees <= 32 bytes and deterministic casing/encoding.


```solidity
function getBytes32InstitutionId(string calldata name) external pure returns (bytes32 id);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`name`|`string`|Human-readable institution name (UTF-8)|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`id`|`bytes32`|bytes32 identifier suitable for on-chain keys|


### getStringInstitutionId

Converts a bytes32 institution id back to a 32-byte string.

Returns the full 32-byte string


```solidity
function getStringInstitutionId(bytes32 id) external pure returns (string memory name);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`id`|`bytes32`|bytes32 institution identifier|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`name`|`string`|32-byte string representation (may contain null bytes)|


### exists

Returns true if an institution id exists (active or disabled)


```solidity
function exists(bytes32 id) external view returns (bool);
```

### getInstitution

Returns the full institution wiring for institution with id `id`

Reverts if the institution does not exist


```solidity
function getInstitution(bytes32 id) external view returns (Institution memory institution);
```

### getConfigurationManager

Returns the ConfigurationManager for institution with id `id`

Reverts if the institution does not exist


```solidity
function getConfigurationManager(bytes32 id) external view returns (address);
```

### getProtocolAccessManager

Returns the ProtocolAccessManager for institution with id `id`

Reverts if the institution does not exist


```solidity
function getProtocolAccessManager(bytes32 id) external view returns (address);
```

### getAdmiralsQuarters

Returns the AdmiralsQuarters for institution with id `id`

Reverts if the institution does not exist


```solidity
function getAdmiralsQuarters(bytes32 id) external view returns (address);
```

### getHarborCommand

Returns the HarborCommand for institution with id `id`

Reverts if the institution does not exist; value is read from the institution's ConfigurationManager


```solidity
function getHarborCommand(bytes32 id) external view returns (address);
```

### addInstitution

MANAGEMENT (onlyGovernor)

Adds a new institution wiring


```solidity
function addInstitution(bytes32 id, Institution calldata institution) external;
```

### removeInstitution

Removes an existing institution id (keeps data visible)


```solidity
function removeInstitution(bytes32 id) external;
```

### updateAdmiralsQuarters

Updates only the AdmiralsQuarters address for institution with id `id`


```solidity
function updateAdmiralsQuarters(bytes32 id, address newAdmiralsQuarters) external;
```

## Structs
### Institution

```solidity
struct Institution {
    address configurationManager;
    address protocolAccessManager;
    address admiralsQuarters;
}
```
